_comment: Build-time defaults. Env vars override: POSTHOG_KEY, POSTHOG_HOST, CONFIG_URL, ADMOB_APP_ID_IOS/_ANDROID, ADMOB_REWARDED_ID_IOS/_ANDROID, ADMOB_INTERSTITIAL_ID_IOS/_ANDROID, ADMOB_TESTING, FLAGS_ADS_DEFAULT, DEV. Nothing here is secret: the PostHog project key is a public write-only key, and AdMob ids are public.
